title: Agent OS User Defaults
description: User-level extension defaults stored at ~/.agent-os/defaults.json. Applied to every project where agent-os is configured. Project-level config.json extensions take precedence over these defaults.

roleExtension.description: Per-role skill and doc overrides for a pipeline stage.

mode.description: extend = apply tech-adaptation first, then add these. replace = skip tech-adaptation for this role and use only what is listed here.

skills.description: Skill names to inject for this role. Resolved in order: project .claude/skills/, user ~/.claude/skills/, plugin.

items.description: Skill name (e.g. 'my-team-guide') or prefixed plugin skill (e.g. 'agent-os:tech-adaptation').

docs.description: Doc file paths the agent reads before starting. Absolute, ~/path, or relative to project root.

items.description: File path.

mode.description: extend = apply tech-adaptation first, then add these. replace = skip tech-adaptation for this role.

skills.description: Skill names to inject for this developer role.

items.description: Skill name or prefixed plugin skill.

docs.description: Doc file paths the developer reads before starting.

items.description: File path.

scaffold_if_new.description: Skill name to run as a project scaffold before the first subtask. Applied only when config.project_type is 'new'.

agentExtension.description: Per-agent skill and doc overrides. Applied on top of any stage or role config. Agent mode wins over role and stage mode.

mode.description: extend = keep stage/role config and add these. replace = use only what is listed here, skipping tech-adaptation.

skills.description: Skill names to inject for this specific agent. Added on top of stage and role skills.

items.description: Skill name or prefixed plugin skill.

docs.description: Doc file paths this agent reads. Added on top of stage and role docs.

items.description: Absolute path, ~/path, or relative to project root.

qaAgentExtension.description: Per-agent overrides for the qa-engineer. Includes extra agents and post-QA commands.

mode.description: extend = apply defaults then add these. replace = use only what is listed here.

skills.description: Skill names to inject for the qa-engineer.

items.description: Skill name or prefixed plugin skill.

docs.description: Doc file paths the qa-engineer reads.

items.description: File path.

agents.description: Extra agent names to run in parallel with qa-engineer.

items.description: Agent name.

commands.description: Commands to run after QA passes. External-effect commands require an approval gate.

items.description: Command name.

context.description: Doc paths loaded by every agent in the pipeline, regardless of stage. Applied before any stage-specific docs.

items.description: Absolute path, ~/path, or path relative to project root.

agents.description: Per-agent skill and doc overrides. Merged on top of stage and role config; agent mode wins. Keys must be plugin agent names.

docs.description: Docs the requirements-analyst reads before capturing requirements.

items.description: File path.
Skill name or prefixed plugin skill.

docs.description: Docs the planner reads before creating the implementation plan.

items.description: File path.
Skill name or prefixed plugin skill.

docs.description: Docs the architect reads before designing.

items.description: File path.
Skill name or prefixed plugin skill.

backend.description: Backend-specific overrides for the design stage.

frontend.description: Frontend-specific overrides for the design stage.

development.description: Extensions for Stage 4: Development. Configured per role only.

docs.description: Docs the QA engineer reads before verifying.

items.description: File path.

skills.description: Additional skills the QA engineer applies.

items.description: Skill name or prefixed plugin skill.

agents.description: Additional agent names to run in parallel with the qa-engineer. Their findings are merged into the QA report.

items.description: Agent name as it appears in .claude/agents/ or ~/.claude/agents/.

commands.description: Commands to run after QA. Commands with external effects (push, deploy) require an approval gate before execution.

items.description: Command name as it appears in .claude/commands/ or ~/.claude/commands/.
